text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion told the Trainer that she 
wanted to enter the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup. Ever since watching the broadcast, it 
seemed to have caught her interest.

She wants to convey her gratitude to 
everyone through this prestigious 
race—responding to her passion, the 
Trainer set their major goal as the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup.

The two discuss the path to reach their 
goal. As a result, they decide to pursue 
the Triple Tiara route, consisting of the 
Oka Sho, Yushun Himba, and Shuka Sho.

Fine Motion felt her anticipation swell 
over what seeing the view from a grand 
stage would bring to her. First, she set 
her sights on her debut, the Oka Sho...!
